title: SybilSight reference-data catalog
description: The document Sybil Sight and Sybil Terminal fetch to discover, download, and update on-device reference datasets. Decoded by ReferenceDataCatalogDocument in LocalPackages/ReferenceData.

manifestVersion.description: Bumped only for a breaking change to this envelope, never for dataset content. A client that cannot read the envelope keeps whatever it already installed.

id.description: Stable identity. Also the container filename: <id>.sqlite3.

symbolName.description: SF Symbol. Empty falls back to the category symbol.

attribution.description: Displayed verbatim. Required by the CC BY and CC BY-SA upstream licences.

bundled.description: True when the app ships this dataset inside its bundle. A downloaded build still supersedes the bundled copy.

version.description: Dotted numeric, compared component-wise — 1.10 is newer than 1.9. Never compared as a string.

schemaVersion.description: Container layout. A client refuses a version it does not implement rather than mis-reading columns.

downloadBytes.description: Transfer size. This is the number the cellular policy is applied to.

installedBytes.description: Post-decompression size, used for the free-space check.

sha256.description: Digest of the DOWNLOADED bytes exactly as transferred — verified before any CPU is spent decompressing them.
